entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...[fName], it seems I didn't get[n]quite enough to eat yet. I'm going to[n]head back for more.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: There goes Yusuke, always doing[n]his own thing...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, he ought to be fine by himself.[n]We should get going too.
